title: MOF-on-MOF Derived Magnetic CoFe2O4@Fe0 Nanocomposites for Ultra-Rapid Peroxymonosulfate Activation: Mechanistic Insights and Eco-Toxicological Validation
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00688K, Communication
Zi-Chen Zhang, Ruo-Xuan Mei, Chong-Chen Wang, Fu-Xue Wang, Yuliang Dong, Jian-Feng Wang
CoFe2O4@Fe0 nanocatalysts derived from epitaxially grown S-BUC-21(Fe)@FeCo-PBA MOF-on-MOF precursors achieved complete atrazine degradation within 5 minutes via peroxymonosulfate activation.
